messages:
devops-carol: Heads up — deploy-bot quarantined the payments chart in eu-west; preflight postinstall job kept getting OOMKilled and we saw the sidecar restart loop because image TTL expired during hook completion. Abort or manual dry-run? :thinking_face:
infra-john: Yep saw that. deploy-bot output: "quarantine triggered: postinstall-job OOMKilled". Nodepool is on bursty spot instances atm.
sara: Any DB migrations tied to this release? If not I lean hotpatch + pin and then fix the hook.
devops-carol: No DB migrations. Root cause looks like a race between the hook job completing and the pod-ttl-gc evicting short-lived pods. The synclocker job sometimes exits 10-20s after creation; podgc kicks in at <30s TTL.
ops-amy: Proposed plan: manual dry-run then pin chart. Run:
```bash
helm upgrade --install payments redwood/payments --namespace payments --version 2.14.3 --set job.memory=256Mi --dry-run --debug
```
If dry-run is clean, apply annotated pin.
devex-mike: For release notes: call out workaround (bump job memory + backoff) and include follow-up ticket. Also verify image digests in registry.
deploy-bot: quarantine created for release payments/eu-west-2023-09-25-rc (chart v2.14.3) — reason: postinstall job OOMKilled
infra-john: Could we pin back to 2.14.2 to avoid the hook execution path that was introduced in 2.14.3? That would be fastest unblock.
devops-carol: Pinning can be done by annotating the release: `kubectl annotate helmrelease payments chart-pin=2.14.2 --overwrite` but deploy-bot needs an exemption to run the annotation (we don't allow manual k8s edits without approval).
sara: I approve manual pin for eu-west for safety. @deploy-bot please exempt and apply pin.
deploy-bot: Received exemption approval from sara. Applying annotation now.
ops-amy: I'll run the dry-run and sanity checks, ETA ~10m.
devops-carol: Also note cross-region: if we unblock eu-west, us-east promotion could pick up same chart. @luis please hold us-east for 30m until eu-west is stable.
luis: Holding us-east promotion for 30m, monitoring logs and image promotion.
devex-mike: Add follow-up ticket INF-1234 to track root cause and revert the pin later. Release notes line: "Hotfix: temporary pin to v2.14.2 due to job TTL race. Follow-up INF-1234." 
devops-carol: Created ticket https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-1234
deploy-bot: dry-run completed — no schema changes detected. Annotated chart-pin=2.14.2 applied. Promotion paused for us-east.
sara: Thanks team. We'll roll forward with the pinned chart and assemble release notes. I'll schedule the hook fix in INF-1234.
ops-amy: Verified logs, sidecar no longer restarting after pin. Promoting pinned release to eu-west now. :thumbsup:
devops-carol: Good catch everyone. After we merge the hook backport, we'll unpin and promote. Remember to include digest checks before unpin.
